name: GlassCN
summary: Apple-inspired glassmorphic components on shadcn and Base UI via registry.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of 26 glass-* registry items (plus non-glass shadcn primitives in same registry — excluded).
Demos are single-page gallery anchors on /components — not per-route docs.
Live demo host is glasscn.vercel.app; registry host is glasscn-components.vercel.app (same project; shadcn @glasscn namespace).
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Glass Button
components.summary: Apple-inspired glassmorphic button with clear/frosted/liquid variants.

demo.peerNotes: shadcn/Base UI project; registry @glasscn resolves to glasscn-components.vercel.app/r/{name}.json

components.copyCode:
# components.json registries:
# "@glasscn": "https://glasscn-components.vercel.app/r/{name}.json"
npx shadcn@latest add @glasscn/glass-button
# or: npx shadcn@latest add https://glasscn-components.vercel.app/r/glass-button.json

import { GlassButton } from "@/components/ui/glasscn/glass-button"

<GlassButton />

copyPrompt.text: Use GlassCN free MIT React component `Glass Button` (slug `glass-button`) from https://glasscn.vercel.app/components#button. Configure shadcn registry `@glasscn` → `https://glasscn-components.vercel.app/r/{name}.json`, then install with `npx shadcn@latest add @glasscn/glass-button` (or direct https://glasscn-components.vercel.app/r/glass-button.json). Home: https://glasscn.vercel.app. Registry homepage: https://glasscn-components.vercel.app/. Repo: https://github.com/kostyniuk/glasscn-components. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kostyniuk/glasscn-components/master/LICENSE; Copyright (c) 2026 Alex Kostyniuk). Pricing free.
